title: fix: prevent single-branch extglob ReDoS (CVE-2026-112366)
body:
Collapse redundant repetition in safe wildcard extglobs and literalize complex forms that cannot be safely simplified. Add regression tests for the reported attack patterns and related bypasses.

Prepare the secured-picomatch 4.0.7-a fork metadata and documentation. Verified lint, 2004 tests, CI coverage, and packed-package installation.
